name: Oleanolic acid
description: Oleanolic acid (CAS 508-02-1 ), also known as Oleanic acid, is a pentacyclic triterpenoid derived from plant sources including olive pomace, cloves, and various medicinal herbs. In industry, it functions as a bioactive intermediate and stabilizing agent across pharmaceutical synthesis and cosmetic formulation. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a key starting material. It is used for the semi-synthesis of more complex triterpenoid derivatives and active pharmaceutical ingredients targeting metabolic and hepatoprotective pathways. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into anti-aging creams. Serums and scalp treatments utilize its antioxidant activity to support product stability and position the formulation for premium positioning. In oral care products, it is used as a functional ingredient. It is found in toothpastes and mouthwashes targeting gum health. Flavor and fragrance applications also draw on its plant-derived profile as a minor acidulant and fixative component in certain botanical extracts. Oleanolic acid is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Standard commercial grades include technical grade for industrial synthesis and high-purity grades for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications. Material sourced from olive or plant extraction is available with documentation supporting natural origin claims.
